answer_1.quote: Given a set of reviews about an entity (such as a hotel), rationale-based opinion summarization outputs representative opinions summarizing the reviews as well as one or more rationales for each representative opinion.
answer_1.outputs: rationale-based opinion summaries consisting of representative opinions and corresponding rationales

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the extracted rationales using automatic (§5.4.1) and human measures (§5.4.2).

answer_4.quote: Each pair of summaries is annotated by three annotators recruited from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compared summaries pairwise based on four criteria: informativeness, non-redundancy, coherence, and usefulness.
